FO.AttackCritText: Crit: x2 damage, target armor reduced one tier
FO.AttackFumbleText1: Out of ammo. You also drop the weapon or otherwise make it unusable until an action is spent fixing it.
FO.AttackFumbleText2: Your weapon misfires/breaks. It has to be repaired outside of combat.
FO.AttackFumbleText3: Your weapon explodes or otherwise hurts you for d6 damage and is beyond repair.
FO.BatteredCyRage: FO-RAGE: gain {hp} temporary HP. Attack random targets 2x per round with your most effective weapon. Attacks are DR10, Defense DR14. Ends when Battered, Dead or sedated.
FO.BatteredCriticalInjury: Critical injury: your {bodyPart} is destroyed and has to be replaced or regrown. You are unable to act for {rounds} {roundsWord} then become active with {hp} HP.
FO.BatteredHemorrhageTwoHours: All tests are +4DR the first hour, +6DR the last hour.
FO.BatteredUnconscious: Fall unconscious for {rounds} {roundsWord}, awaken with {hp} HP.
FO.BreakdownParanoiaText: Whenever you rest, test Occult DR10 or the rest gives you no benefit and you lose d4 SP. −1 Occult.
FO.BreakdownObsessiveRitualsText: When under acute stress test Occult DR10 or become fixated on your ritual for a round or a brief moment and lose d4 SP.
FO.BreakdownMindEclipseText: After wielding a Boon, test Occult DR12 or lose d4 SP. −2 Occult.
FO.BreakdownTeratophobiaText: Whenever you face something that is neither Folk nor beast, you lose d4 SP and have DR +2 on all tests while in its presence. −1 Occult
FO.BreakdownThanatophobiaText: Whenever you witness a death, lose d4 SP. −1 Occult.
FO.BreakdownMothText: You can no longer spend Threads. If not using this optional rule, lose −3 Occult instead.
FO.BreakdownHypochondriaText: Whenever you rest, test Occult DR12 or you suffer from imagined infection. −1 Occult.
FO.BreakdownFlashbacksText: Whenever you fail a Toughness test in combat, lose d4 SP. −1 Occult.
FO.DefendFumbleText: Fumble: Take x2 damage, armor reduced one tier.
FO.EditAllowedScvmClassesMenuHint: Edit the allowed classes in the character generator.
FO.ThreadsHelpHtml:
• Deal maximum damage
  • Reroll a dice roll
  • Lower damage taken by d6
  • Neutralize a Crit or Fumble
  • Lower one test's DR by -4 (before rolling)
FO.InjuryGuttedText: Test Toughness DR12 every round or die.
FO.LevelUpHelp: The Game Master decides when a character should improve, after completing missions, getting enough silver, etc.
FO.LevelUpInTheLining: In the lining of your jacket you find
FO.LevelUpJacketMagAndBooster: A forgotten mag and a random booster mod
FO.LevelUpJacketPebbleInfect: A faintly glowing pebble... it infects you!
FO.LevelUpJacketPebbleNothing: A faintly glowing pebble... it does nothing.
FO.Name: Name
FO.RestLongHelp: Have some sleep, recover D6 HP and D6 SP.
FO.RestShortHelp: Sit down, catch your breath. Recover D4 HP and SP.

FO.SettingsApplyOvercapacityPenaltyHint: +2 STR/AGI DR when carrying more than STR+8 items
FO.SettingsColorSchemeHint: Choose a color scheme for the UI.
FO.SettingsSoundEffectsHint: Play sound effects for various events (combat, etc)
FO.StarvingHelp: No healing when resting, lose d4 HP. All tests are +2DR per restless day.
